biography.value:
Description

Seemingly carved from a dark blue stone, this sinister crouching humanoid resembles a horned, winged demon. Usually found dual-wielding swords. Occasionally just called a “gargoyle,” but that's the name of the entire creature family, not this one in particular. - Imban

Defense

AC 23, touch 14, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +9 natural)

hp 95 [140] (10d10+40)

mp 11

Fort +7, Ref +11, Will +10

DR 10/cold iron;

Immune silenced;

Resist earth 15, lightning 50%

Weakness wind

Offense

Speed 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)

Melee mwk shortsword +13/+8/+3 (1d6+4), mwk shortsword +13/+8 (1d6+4), bite +12 (1d6+2), gore +12 (1d6+2)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Blood Drain, Silence Song, Spooky Laugh

Spells Known (SC CL 10th; concentration +13)

1st (DC 14) - Blizzard, Fire, Thunder

Statistics

Str 18, Dex 19, Con 18, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 8

Base Atk +10; CMB +17; CMD 29

Feats Double Slice, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Multiattack, Two-Weapon Rend, Two-Weapon Fighting

Skills Fly +18, Perception +17, Survival +17, Stealth +20 (+24 in stony areas); Racial Modifiers +2 Stealth (+6 in stony environments)

Languages Common, Terran

SQ Freeze

Ecology

Environment volcanic regions

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure standard (2 mwk shortswords, other treasure)

description.value: An avizzard can siphon blood from a target within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 18 Fortitude save or take 2d8 shadow damage and the avizzard is healed for that much. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

save.description: Negates damage and healing; heal actual shadow damage dealt.

effect: Negates damage and healing; heal actual shadow damage dealt.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

description.value: An avizzard can hold itself so still, it appears to be a statue. An avizzard that uses freeze can take 20 on its Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a stone statue.

Every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, an avizzard can sing a quieting tune at a victim within 30 feet, muting them. The target must make a DC 18 Will save or suffer the Silenced status for 1d4+1 rounds. This is a sonic effect.

Every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, an avizzard can mock and laugh at a victim within 30 feet, driving them into confusion. The target must make a DC 18 Will save or suffer the Confused status for 1d3 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting effect.
Off-hand +13/+8. Full Strength to damage from Double Slice.
